mapper.sql: id, identity_type, identity_value, existing_contact_id, incoming_contact_id, source, status, resolved_by, resolved_at, raw_context, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_identity_conflict ( identity_type, identity_value, existing_contact_id, incoming_contact_id, source, status, raw_context, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{identityType}, #{identityValue}, #{existingContactId}, COALESCE(#{incomingContactId}, ''), #{source}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'pending'), #{rawContext}, now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (identity_type, identity_value, existing_contact_id, incoming_contact_id) WHERE status = 'pending' DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_identity_conflict SET status = 'resolved', resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_at = now(), update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE crm_identity_conflict SET status = 'ignored', resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_at = now(), update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
